aorta.name: Aorta
aorta.definition: The aorta is the main arterial trunk, conveying blood from the left ventricle to the body.

autochthonous-back-muscle.name: Deep back muscles
autochthonous-back-muscle.definition: The deep or intrinsic muscles of the back extend and rotate the vertebral column.

brachiocephalic-trunk.name: Brachiocephalic trunk
brachiocephalic-trunk.definition: The brachiocephalic trunk is the first and largest branch of the aortic arch, ascending to the right of the trachea to divide into the right common carotid and right subclavian arteries.

brachiocephalic-vein.name: Brachiocephalic vein
brachiocephalic-vein.definition: The brachiocephalic veins form behind the sternal ends of the clavicles from the internal jugular and subclavian veins and unite to form the superior vena cava.

cervical-vertebra.name: Cervical vertebra
cervical-vertebra.definition: The cervical vertebrae are the smallest of the movable vertebrae and bear foramina in their transverse processes.

clavicle.name: Clavicle
clavicle.definition: The clavicle forms the anterior portion of the shoulder girdle.

common-carotid-artery.name: Common carotid artery
common-carotid-artery.definition: The common carotid arteries ascend in the neck within the carotid sheath beside the trachea and larynx, the right arising from the brachiocephalic trunk and the left from the aortic arch.

esophagus.name: Oesophagus
esophagus.definition: The oesophagus is a muscular canal passing from the pharynx through the posterior mediastinum to the stomach.

heart.name: Heart
heart.definition: The heart is a hollow muscular organ enclosed in the pericardium, occupying the middle mediastinum.

inferior-vena-cava.name: Inferior vena cava
inferior-vena-cava.definition: The inferior vena cava returns blood from the lower half of the body to the right atrium.

liver.name: Liver
liver.definition: The liver is the largest gland in the body, occupying the right hypochondrium and extending into the epigastrium.

lower-lobe-left.name: Lower lobe of left lung
lower-lobe-left.definition: The lower lobe of the left lung lies posteroinferior to the oblique fissure.

lower-lobe-right.name: Lower lobe of right lung
lower-lobe-right.definition: The lower lobe of the right lung lies below and behind the oblique fissure.

middle-lobe-right.name: Middle lobe of right lung
middle-lobe-right.definition: The middle lobe of the right lung is a wedge lying between the horizontal and oblique fissures.

spinal-cord.name: Spinal cord
spinal-cord.definition: The spinal cord is the elongated part of the central nervous system occupying the upper two-thirds of the vertebral canal.

spleen.name: Spleen
spleen.definition: The spleen is a highly vascular organ situated in the left hypochondrium between the fundus of the stomach and the diaphragm.

sternum.name: Sternum
sternum.definition: The sternum is a flat narrow bone forming the middle of the anterior thoracic wall.

stomach.name: Stomach
stomach.definition: The stomach is the most dilated part of the digestive tube, lying between the oesophagus and the duodenum.

subclavian-artery.name: Subclavian artery
subclavian-artery.definition: The subclavian arteries arch over the apex of each lung to supply the upper limb, the right arising from the brachiocephalic trunk and the left from the aortic arch.

superior-vena-cava.name: Superior vena cava
superior-vena-cava.definition: The superior vena cava returns blood from the head, neck and upper limbs to the right atrium, formed by the union of the two brachiocephalic veins.

thoracic-vertebra.name: Thoracic vertebra
thoracic-vertebra.definition: The thoracic vertebrae are distinguished by costal facets on the sides of their bodies.

thyroid-gland.name: Thyroid gland
thyroid-gland.definition: The thyroid gland is a vascular endocrine gland of two lateral lobes joined by an isthmus, clasping the front and sides of the upper trachea.

trachea.name: Trachea
trachea.definition: The trachea is a tube of incomplete cartilaginous rings and membrane that descends from the lower border of the larynx to divide into the two main bronchi in the thorax.

upper-lobe-left.name: Upper lobe of left lung
upper-lobe-left.definition: The left lung is divided by the oblique fissure into an upper and a lower lobe; the upper lobe includes the lingula.

upper-lobe-right.name: Upper lobe of right lung
upper-lobe-right.definition: The upper lobe of the right lung lies above the horizontal fissure and in front of the upper part of the oblique fissure.
